hints.title: Running Streak Counting
hints.text: Contiguous ones form runs that end whenever a zero occurs. Tracking the current run length finds the longest sequence.

hints.title: Streak Reset Invariant
hints.text: Incrementing the current counter on ones and updating the maximum seen, while resetting to zero on zeros, captures the longest run in one pass.

hints.title: Linear Streak Comparison Procedure
hints.text: Initialize max count and current count to zero. Loop through all numbers in the array. If the number is one, increment current count and update max count. If the number is zero, reset current count to zero. Return max count.

hints.title: See the blueprint

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Generating all subarrays takes quadratic O(N^2) time and causes unnecessary nested checks.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: A single linear scan updates streak counters in O(N) time and requires strictly O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should quickly implement the single-pass streak counter and discuss sliding window variants.
